# Copilot Instructions

<!-- Use this file to provide workspace-specific custom instructions to Copilot. For more details, visit https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/copilot-customization#_use-a-githubcopilotinstructionsmd-file -->

This is an AI-powered budget planning website with the following key features:

## Project Overview
- **Next.js 15** with TypeScript and App Router
- **Tailwind CSS** for styling with responsive design
- **International currency support** for global users
- **AI shopping assistant** that searches multiple stores (Amazon, Walmart, Target)
- **Affiliate link integration** system
- **User authentication** with quota system (50 free uses, then $20/year)
- **Location-based product recommendations**
- **Budget optimization** with alternative suggestions

## Key Components
- Shopping assistant with AI-powered product search
- Multi-currency support with real-time conversion
- User quota tracking and subscription management
- Affiliate link management
- Product comparison and budget optimization
- Responsive international design

## Code Style
- Use TypeScript with strict types
- Follow Next.js 15 App Router patterns
- Use Tailwind CSS utility classes
- Implement proper error handling
- Include loading states and user feedback
- Ensure accessibility compliance
- Support multiple languages and currencies
